study_design: Single-center, randomized, open-label trial with blinded outcome adjudication; modified intention-to-treat analysis
outcome_definition: Creatinine-only AKI within 7 days after CABG, defined as meeting at least one stage 1 serum-creatinine criterion under AKIN, RIFLE, or KDIGO; urine output was not included.
source_location: Pages 3-4 and 7, Study Outcomes/Primary Outcomes sections and Table 2
extraction_note: Empagliflozin plus standard care versus standard care alone. The article explicitly states that the primary outcome was based solely on serum creatinine. AKIN and KDIGO identified the same 16 versus 29 patients as the composite primary AKI outcome. Raw randomized arm-level data are reported.

study_design: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial; post hoc creatinine-only analysis
outcome_definition: AKI within 7 days after cardiac surgery defined exclusively by KDIGO serum-creatinine criteria, excluding urine-output criteria.
source_location: Page 7, Post Hoc Outcomes; creatinine-only results reported with reference to Supplement 2, eTable 3
extraction_note: Dapagliflozin versus placebo. This post hoc analysis explicitly isolated serum-creatinine-defined AKI from urine-output-defined AKI. Raw randomized arm-level data and the unadjusted RR are reported.
